get.description: Bootstrap the explicit account selector for the operator console.

AccountConfigDraftResponse.title: AccountConfigDraftResponse
AccountConfigDraftResponse.description:
Explicitly account-scoped, not-yet-applied strategy configuration.

``config`` is the stored ``StrategyConfigBody`` (the PUT is its only writer).

BlockedScope.title: BlockedScope
BlockedScope.description: The account, environment and symbol an open uncertainty blocks.

CancelAllPhase.title: CancelAllPhase
CancelAllPhase.description: The latest venue cancel-all phase of one currency for the HALTED in force.

CurrencyPolicy.title: CurrencyPolicy
CurrencyPolicy.description: A currency with an applied policy; an unreadable one has ``policy_error`` and nulls.

ExchangeAccountResponse.title: ExchangeAccountResponse
ExchangeAccountResponse.description: One account visible to the authenticated operator bootstrap (never a retired one).

ExecutionEventResponse.title: ExecutionEventResponse
ExecutionEventResponse.description:
One execution-history row: a ledger journal row, or below the switch a row of the frozen
``legacy_archive.event_log``. ``eventKey`` is opaque (ADR 2026-10-02 D4).

ExecutionsPage.title: ExecutionsPage
ExecutionsPage.description: ``GET /executions``: the envelope plus the opaque cursor of the next page.

FundingStatus.title: FundingStatus
FundingStatus.description: ``/admin/trading-status`` with the dry run of ``/admin/dry-evaluate`` under ``dry_run``.

OfferClaimResponse.title: OfferClaimResponse
OfferClaimResponse.description: One managed offer. ``offerKey`` is opaque and stable for the offer's life.

OfferEnvelope.title: OfferEnvelope
OfferEnvelope.description: The terms every new offer must stay inside; decimals stay strings.

PositionResponse.title: PositionResponse
PositionResponse.description:
One symbol's capital as disjoint components, in the symbol's own units.

``available + offered + lent`` is the symbol's total. ``unattributedLent`` is a
subset of ``lent`` (never an addend); null when the authority has no such fact.

ProfileResponse.title: ProfileResponse
ProfileResponse.description: The operator identity Tailscale Serve forwards.

PublicWeeklyPoint.title: PublicWeeklyPoint
PublicWeeklyPoint.description:
One week of the public proof-page series — percent-only, no absolute
$ fields (see modules/api/public.py for the compliance rationale).

Range.title: Range
Range.description:
A {min, max} bound. min/max must be positive and min <= max. Used for
amount, rate (daily ratio) and period. Modelled as float to keep zero
divergence from the FE's single rangeSchema (which types all three as
number); period values are integers by convention (FE step=1).

ResolutionRequestResponse.title: ResolutionRequestResponse
ResolutionRequestResponse.description: One queued adjudication and, once the daemon has settled it, its outcome.

StrategyConfigBody.title: StrategyConfigBody
StrategyConfigBody.description:
Validated PUT /configs body. Mirrors the FE Zod strategyConfigSchema
(positive ranges, min<=max, non-empty currency). Stored verbatim as the
user_configs.config JSONB blob. The backend is unit-agnostic on rate; it
stores the daily ratio the FE sends and never converts.

UncertaintyResolutionContext.title: UncertaintyResolutionContext
UncertaintyResolutionContext.description: Server-derived, bounded inputs for one audited operator action.

UncertaintyResponse.title: UncertaintyResponse
UncertaintyResponse.description: Bounded operator-console uncertainty DTO (never raw event payload).
